description: Add the user's own submission to a store so others can see real wait times. Only call with the user's permission and for a real submission. The private link to update the report later is emailed to the address given, never returned in the conversation.

decided_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD, required unless status is waiting

email.description: Optional. The reporter’s email address; the private update link is sent there. Not stored.

listing_ref.description: Optional, private. Directory link, ChatGPT app id, MCP server URL or repository; the report is marked approved when that listing appears.

name: report_submission

emailed.description: Whether the private update link was emailed

title: Report a store submission
